title: Delete your account
description: How to permanently delete your Savlo account and the personal data associated with it, from inside the app or by request.

content.text: This page explains how to permanently delete your **Savlo** account (developer: Savlo, package com.savlo.app) and the personal data associated with it. There are two ways to do it: from inside the app, or by sending us a request.
Savlo is a mobile app only — there is no web version, so there is nothing on this website to sign in to. That is why requests made without the app are handled by email.

sections.heading: Option 1 — Delete it yourself from the app

content.text: This is the fastest route and it is immediate. If you still have Savlo installed:
Your account and its data are erased right away and your session is closed on every device. **This cannot be undone.**
If you want to keep a copy of your records first, use Settings → Export my data before deleting.

sections.heading: Option 2 — Request deletion without the app

content.text: If you have already uninstalled Savlo or cannot access your account, email us and we will delete it for you:

Send the request from the email address registered on the account (if you signed up with Google, use that same Google address). We use that as verification. If you write from a different address we will ask you to confirm ownership before deleting anything, because an unverified deletion request from a stranger would itself be a security problem.
Deleting your account removes your login credentials and, in cascade, everything tied to them:

items: Your profile, email address and app settings
All movements: expenses, income, transfers and reserves
Accounts, balances, sinking funds and their contributions
Recurring rules and their scheduled occurrences
Imported files and their processing history
AI assistant conversations and the memories built from them

sections.heading: What we keep, and for how long

content.text: A small amount of data survives the deletion, and only for these reasons:

items: Encrypted backups. Your data may persist in our database backups for up to 30 days after deletion, isolated from any further processing, until those backups rotate out.
Analytics and crash reports. Diagnostic events (Sentry, PostHog) are deleted or stripped of any identifier within 30 days of your request.
Billing and tax records. If you ever purchased a subscription, the transaction records are kept for as long as tax and accounting law requires. They contain the purchase, not your financial data.
By email: we complete the deletion within 30 days of verifying the request, and normally much sooner. We confirm by email once it is done.

content.text: Deleting your Savlo account does **not** cancel a paid subscription on its own. Subscriptions are billed by Google Play, so you also need to cancel it there: Play Store → your profile → Payments and subscriptions → Subscriptions → Savlo → Cancel. Do this before deleting the account so you are not billed again.
Write to support@savloapp.com. For the full picture of what we collect and why, see our Privacy Policy.
